name: MOS Utility Ltd.
summary: MOS Utility Ltd. is an India-based financial technology company operating a unified open API and wallet platform. The company provides a broad spectrum of digital products and services across banking, utility, travel, insurance, entertainment, courier and cargo, and digital marketing. Its offerings include instant digital money transfers, Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AEPS), Micro ATM services, utility bill payments, booking for flights, hotels, trains, and buses, and various insurance products. The company targets individuals and local retailers, especially in rural and semi-urban areas across India, operating through a B2C, B2B, and B2B2C model with an extensive network of agents and distributors. MOS Utility Ltd. is also strategically expanding into the solar power sector, aiming to manufacture and trade solar products, subject to shareholder approval.
